# Properties: recognized fields, ignored unsupported input, and literal prose

## Input boundary

```````````````````````````````` example
---
title: Note
tags: [a, b]
---
Body
.
Document scope=1:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Metadata scope=1:1..4:3 name=null title=scalar(text("Note")) subtitle=null time=null date=null authors=null keywords=null abstract=null state=null comment=null children=0
└── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=5:1..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Body" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Fixed-field and text/list forms

```````````````````````````````` example
---
abstract: |
  before
→
  after
state: ready
---
body
````````````````````````````````

## Fixed-field and text/list forms

```````````````````````````````` example
---
abstract: |#bad
  text
abstract: valid
name: "text"#bad
name: valid
---
body
.
````````````````````````````````
